items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: what's wrong with the things that Norman Granz Graham does

ctx.x: Yeah, well, it's all over the street. I've had many, many calls from jazz musicians who want to come with us. But we'll see about that. You know, I did all the gospel over at ABC, also; I did that because I ran in to a lot of young people that I thought had a lot of talent, and no one was recording them, and so I just started recording them for Duke Peacock -- that's the label that ABC acquired.

But all in all, the only reason I changed jobs was because of the carrying of the jazz label. And if you get a chance to build it yourself, then I wont' have to sit around and say what's wrong with the things that Norman Granz Graham does, you know?
